notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement Total column (p4); beginning_cash/ending_cash are the printed total fund balances (cash and county treasurer cash; Statement p3 total assets 1,965,236, no liabilities). Business-type from the proprietary revenues/expenses statement (p6, measure net position since statement rolls net position incl. capital assets); receipts total computed. Balance sheet is the government-wide modified cash Statement of Net Position (p1). Transfers: gov in 1,582,854 / out 1,568,581 and business in 266,700 / out 280,973 total 1,849,554 each, matching the budget schedule p7. Detail: only the all-funds budget schedule (p7, mixes governmental and business-type funds, printed totals include transfers in/out; lines with blank actual (Federal receipts, State aid) omitted). The p8 combining schedule of other governmental funds (nonmajor funds: county treasurer revenues 66,457, interest 4,937, charges 40,136, grant 75,000, other revenues 178,501 = 365,031; Public Safety 431,960, Culture and Recreation 742,569, Community Development 16,706, Public Works - other 27,906, Capital outlay 484,203 = 1,703,344; transfers 1,233,513) is NOT recorded in detail because those amounts are already inside the p7 all-funds lines (no double counting); p7 covers every fund and cannot be split by fund, so it was kept. 'Other local receipts' (p7) is a mixed line categorised as charges for services/fees (dominant, about 3.59M) with review. Transfer cross-check found no hidden transfers. Business-type operating expense lines (p6) are split by column: Golf Course column (359,057 total) as culture/recreation, the Water/Sewer/Sewer Treatment/Garbage remainder as utilities. Read pages 1-8 of 8. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) replace the combined schedule.
